gold_points: Union agreements may be incompatible with acquisition targets, or targets may not want to join a union-based company
Some customers prefer non-union workforces and may reduce work if non-union crews unionize
Underfunded multiemployer pension plans can create substantial withdrawal or termination liabilities
Endangered or critical status plans may require surcharges or additional contributions
output.note: First chunk alone covers union and multiemployer pension risk; second chunk covers unrelated FCPA and tax topics.
output.question: In its fiscal 2020 10-K, how does Quanta Services, Inc. explain that its union status and multiemployer pension plan obligations could adversely affect the company?
